module: "Suspect" traffic role: a vehicle wanted by the police. It defines the actions watchPolice (become wanted), fleePolice (flee), arrest (immobilize) and clear (reset). As long as its state is 'wanted' and the police have seen it enough, it triggers a pursuit via gameplay_police.
notes: Flags manipulated in self.flags: flee, busy, freeze, driveCheck (read), pursuit/reset (read on police vehicles).
fleePolice makes the vehicle almost impossible to respawn by calling veh:modifyRespawnValues(800, 40).

C.desc: Suspect role class, completed by baseRole (self.veh = traffic vehicle, self.flags, self.state, self.actions).

init.desc: Initializes the role: adds a +0.2 offset to aggression (personalityModifiers), defines the actions watchPolice / fleePolice / arrest / clear and sets pursuitMode = 2.

onRoleEnded.desc: Called when the role ends. If the suspect was fleeing, calls gameplay_police.evadeVehicle(vehId, gameplay_traffic.showMessages) and removes the flee flag.

onActiveDone.desc: Called when the vehicle is no longer active in traffic. Same handling as onRoleEnded: if the flee flag is set, the suspect is declared to have escaped the police.

onTrafficTick.desc: Called on each traffic manager tick. If the state is 'wanted', the visibility value (pursuit.sightValue) reaches the threshold (0.25 for an AI, 1 for a player) and the speed reaches the threshold (1 m/s if driveCheck, otherwise 0), it looks for available police officers (neither in pursuit nor in reset), starts gameplay_police.setPursuitMode(pursuitMode, vehId, policeIds) and targets the closest police officer.

tickTime.desc: Traffic tick duration in seconds (not used in the body).
